considered_not_added: Tominersen population PK model (2023; doi:10.1002/psp4.13001): in silico, built on 750 patients' CSF/plasma PK and used to choose GENERATION HD2 doses; no published comparison of its prediction with a later trial result, and it is fitted to patient data rather than a preclinical model.

Iwamoto 2024 tominersen-surrogate (HTT-2723) in patient iPSC neurons: same system as the draft's hd-ipsc-neuron-snp-aso track, so not a new model; a possible second retro entry on that track (checker missing list).
Southwell 2015 Hu97/18 humanized mouse (CSF HTT tracks brain HTT lowering): the same HD mouse/NHP ASO system as hd-mouse-nhp-aso-htt; better used as model_src for engagement 4 than as a new track.
Caron 2022 (Neurobiol Dis) mouse CSF mHTT biomarker study: tests whether CSF mHTT reflects striatal lowering in mice; no comparison with a member drug's patient result.

Wave published preclinical data for WVE-120101/120102 before PRECISION-HD: none found; Iwamoto 2017 (Nat Biotechnol, doi:10.1038/nbt.3948) is about stereopure mipomersen, not HTT. Wave's model stays unpublished.
Human genetic HTT loss-of-function / haploinsufficiency carriers: no source compares them with a member drug's patient engagement, dose or safety result.

Patient-derived cells or PDX-style co-clinical selection, human challenge, regulator reliance on model data: none exist for this class (no NDA/BLA; FDA declined the external control for AMT-130 in Nov 2025).
